description: This file contains shell script functions related to migrating and removing sysfs entries for LEDs, mainly manipulating UCI configurations and logging.

methods.name: migrate_led_sysfs
methods.description: Updates the sysfs path for a LED configuration based on provided tuples.

methods.name: remove_devicename_led_sysfs
methods.description: Removes the device name prefix from the sysfs path for a LED configuration if certain conditions are met.

methods.name: migrate_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and applies led sysfs migration to all LEDs.

methods.name: remove_devicename_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and removes device name prefixes for all LEDs.

methods.name: migrations_apply
methods.description: Commits configuration changes to a specified UCI realm if there are pending changes.
